Title: AUTOSAR Integration Engineer
Description: Job Title: AUTOSAR Integration Engineer (ADP Software Platform) Job Type: Full-Time Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior AUTOSAR Integration Engineer to lead the configuration, integration, and bring-up of AUTOSAR architecture for advanced development platform (ADP) software-only releases. This role involves close collaboration with software architects and embedded engineers to translate high-level system designs into robust AUTOSAR configurations, ensuring seamless integration and early-stage validation. Key Responsibilities Lead the configuration, integration, and bring-up of AUTOSAR architecture, including MCAL, BSW, and RTE layers for software-only releases. Collaborate with Software Architects to interpret high-level system architecture and translate it into AUTOSAR configurations and component definitions. Work closely with Embedded Software Engineers to integrate internally developed modules into the AUTOSAR environment. Configure and manage AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) modules, including: Communication stack (CAN/LIN) Diagnostics (UDS, DCM, DEM) Memory services Watchdog Operating System (OS) ECU State Management Perform RTE generation and ensure proper interface alignment across application software components. Maintain and manage AUTOSAR toolchains (e.g., Vector DaVinci or OEM-specific tools). Support early-stage integration, debugging, and issue resolution across the AUTOSAR stack. Define and support MCAL usage, microcontroller abstraction, and hardware service layer behavior, including in virtual or software-only environments. Contribute to simulation and virtual integration setups for early validation of AUTOSAR configurations. Support power mode management and diagnostic integration from an AUTOSAR perspective. Conduct static analysis, configuration validation, and support verification and QA activities. Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes and contribute to functional safety activities aligned with ISO 26262. Support development and integration of SENT (SAE J2716) communication interfaces and related AUTOSAR configurations for prototype hardware. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or higher degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 10+ years of experience in automotive embedded software development. Strong hands-on experience with AUTOSAR Classic Platform, including: MCAL, BSW, ECU Abstraction OS configuration RTE generation Communication stacks (CAN/LIN) Diagnostics (UDS, DCM, DEM), power management, and memory services Proficiency with AUTOSAR toolchains such as Vector DaVinci or equivalent. Proven experience integrating application software into AUTOSAR systems and resolving configuration and interface issues. Strong embedded C programming and debugging skills. Experience with microcontrollers such as TriCore, NXP S32, Renesas, or similar. Hands-on experience with CANalyzer/CANoe for communication analysis and validation. Familiarity with static analysis tools, configuration validation, and unit testing. Understanding of ASPICE processes and basic functional safety concepts (ISO 26262). Soft Skills Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AUTOSAR concepts to cross-functional teams. Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with architects and development teams. Highly organized, self-driven, and capable of guiding early-phase technical direction. Comfortable working in a global, cross-cultural engineering environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in safety-critical automotive domains such as occupant sensing or airbag systems. Prior involvement in advanced development programs, platform bring-up, or early-stage architecture exploration. Familiarity with functional safety work products and safety analysis techniques such as FMEA or FMEDA.

Title: Hyperautomation Engineer

Support and Operations: Provide 2nd/3rd line support for applications and platforms, including incident/task/change/release management aligned to AstraZeneca standards. Integration and Data: Build integrations using Power Platform connectors, custom connectors, Graph API, SharePoint REST, and manage data models in Dataverse and SQL. Stakeholder Collaboration: Liaise with business stakeholders, product owners, infra/middleware teams, and 3rd-party vendors to resolve issues, prioritize backlog, and identify process improvements. Essential Experience (Must Have at least 3 years of experience) Power Platform proficiency: Hands-on experience with Power Apps (canvas and/or model-driven), Power Automate flows, Dataverse schema design, security roles, and environment management. Modern SharePoint: Experience with SharePoint Online from an application perspective (sites, lists, libraries, permissions, REST/Graph API); SPFx exposure is a plus but not mandatory. AI awareness: Understanding of AI capabilities in Microsoft 365 (Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Builder) and ability to scope, design, or support AI-enabled solutions; experience with agent-based automations is desirable. Web fundamentals: Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS for customizing Power Platform and modern SharePoint experiences. Support discipline: Strong grasp of incident, problem, change, and release management processes; experience running production support for business-critical applications. Integration and APIs: Experience building solutions with standard Power Platform connectors, custom connectors, Graph/REST APIs, and basic SQL/data handling. Documentation and governance: Ability to document solutions, configurations, runbooks, and maintain alignment to enterprise standards and compliance. Supplementary Experience (Nice To Have) SPFx development: Experience with SPFx, React, Fluent UI, and SharePoint PnP libraries. DevOps practices: Familiarity with Azure DevOps/GitHub for source control, pipelines, ALM accelerators, solution packaging, and environment strategies. Data and reporting: Knowledge of Power BI, data modeling, and performance optimization for analytics scenarios. Security and compliance: Understanding of DLP policies, data residency, and role-based access in Power Platform and M365. Application environment management: Experience setting up and managing dev/test/prod environments, feature flags, and configuration. Personal Attributes Learning mindset: Keen to acquire new skills, especially evolving Power Platform and AI capabilities. Clear communicator: Strong written and verbal communication; able to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Operational resilience: Comfortable participating in on-call rotation and providing support for critical applications. Collaboration and independence: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work autonomously and in global, cross-functional teams. Analytical problem solver: Logical thinker with a structured approach to troubleshooting, RCA, and continuous improvement. Customer focus: Balance between developer excellence and support responsiveness, with a mindset to maintain and enhance business-critical solutions. Title: Lead Data Engineer

This role is ideal for someone with deep experience in cloud-native data engineering (preferably AWS), combined with the flexibility to work across a variety of platforms, tools, and business use cases, especially in marketing, billing, and customer lifecycle analytics. Strong Python and SQL skills (complex queries, transformations, optimization) Hands-on experience building pipelines using APIs, file ingestion (SFTP), and third-party integrations Strong understanding of data modeling and data warehouse design (Kimball or similar) Experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redshift) Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and version control (Git) Experience working with subscription or SaaS metrics (MRR, churn, LTV, etc.) Nice to Have: Experience with Zuora, RevenueCat, Salesforce, or similar platforms Exposure to BI tools (QuickSight, Looker, Tableau) Experience supporting marketing attribution and lifecycle analytics Experience with data testing or validation frameworks Knowledge of data governance, privacy, and security best practices in enterprise environments.
